domain_setting: A connected everyday leisure world across a comfortable home, craft table, neighborhood venues, parks, trails, and social outings. Keep people visibly enjoying an activity; avoid school, work, shopping logistics, and abstract hobby symbols without a user or purpose.

ambient_palette.home_and_studio: warm ivory, light wood, soft blue-grey, and a few lively craft colors
ambient_palette.outdoors: sage greens, sky blue, sunlit sand, and muted trail earth
ambient_palette.social_venues: warm indoor light, calm navy shadows, and varied clothing tones
ambient_palette.digital_and_media: cool screen blue balanced with warm room light

recurring_scale_anchors: A recurring adult or friend-group scale cue for leisure activities
Warm domestic surfaces for crafts, cooking, reading, and games
A window, doorway, chair, or bag when it clarifies a home activity or outing
Recognizable park, trail, beach, gallery, gym, or performance venue details for out-of-home activities
Small purposeful hobby tools such as needles, camera, book, game pieces, or instrument

polysemy_resolution_table.hobby: A leisure pursuit shown through a person enjoying a chosen craft or pastime; not work or a job.
polysemy_resolution_table.bake / baking: Preparing food with an oven as a leisure activity; baking is the activity or process, while bake is the action.
polysemy_resolution_table.cook / cooking: Cook is a person preparing a home meal for pleasure, consistent with the glossary's chef sense; cooking is the food-preparation activity.
polysemy_resolution_table.draw (art): Make a picture with a pencil or charcoal; not pull or drag an object.
polysemy_resolution_table.paint: Create an artwork with a brush and colored paint on a canvas; not household wall paint or a paint can.
polysemy_resolution_table.photography / take photos: Photography is the camera-based hobby and finished image; take photos is the act of framing and pressing a camera shutter.
polysemy_resolution_table.pottery / do pottery: Pottery is a finished ceramic vessel or ceramic craft; do pottery shows a person shaping clay at a wheel.
polysemy_resolution_table.puzzles / do puzzles: Puzzles are tabletop jigsaw or logic games; the activity card shows pieces being assembled, not a confused person.
polysemy_resolution_table.cards / play cards: Cards are playing cards used at a table; not greeting cards, business cards, or tarot.
polysemy_resolution_table.gaming / video games / play video games: This group means recreational digital gaming, not gambling; distinguish the general hobby, game medium, and a person using a controller.
polysemy_resolution_table.browse the internet / surf the internet: Both mean exploring websites online; not swimming or ocean surfing. Keep screens and browsing behavior visible.
polysemy_resolution_table.stream: Deliver music or video over the internet to a device; not a small flowing river.
polysemy_resolution_table.book club / go to a book club: A social reading group that discusses books, as required by the surrounding free-time vocabulary; not a book discount sales organization.
polysemy_resolution_table.movie / see a play: Movie is a film shown on a screen; a play is a live stage performance with actors and scenery.
polysemy_resolution_table.musical instrument / play a musical inst: An instrument is the object itself; the verb phrase shows a person performing on it.
polysemy_resolution_table.music / listen to music: Music is an enjoyable sound or performance; listen to music shows a person attending to sound, preferably with headphones or a speaker.
polysemy_resolution_table.concert / go to a concert / sing in a ch: A concert is a live band performance for an audience; going to one shows an attendee entering or watching; a choir sings together; karaoke is one person singing to a backing track with a microphone.
polysemy_resolution_table.exercise / do exercise / gym / go to the: Exercise is physical activity; doing exercise is the action; a gym is the fitness venue; going to the gym shows travel to it; yoga uses a calm mat pose rather than weights.
polysemy_resolution_table.birdwatching / go birdwatching: Observe wild birds outdoors with binoculars; not keeping pet birds.
polysemy_resolution_table.camping / go camping: Camping is an overnight leisure stay in a tent outdoors; going camping shows a person carrying or setting up gear at a campsite.
polysemy_resolution_table.foraging / go foraging: Gathering edible wild plants or berries responsibly; not shopping for produce or hunting.
polysemy_resolution_table.hike / hiking / jogging / go jogging / w: A hike is a purposeful walk along an outdoor trail; hiking is the pastime; jogging is a light run; walking here is a relaxed leisure stroll.
polysemy_resolution_table.ride a horse: Leisure horseback riding with a saddle and mounted rider; not a camel or a transport vehicle.
polysemy_resolution_table.free time activities: An overview of several distinct leisure pursuits; not one sport or a work schedule.
polysemy_resolution_table.beach / go to the beach: Beach is the sandy or pebbled shore; going to the beach shows people arriving or spending leisure time at the shoreline.
polysemy_resolution_table.go out / hang out / meet friends / call: Go out is leaving home for a social outing; hang out is relaxed time together; meet friends shows people reuniting; call friends is a phone conversation.
polysemy_resolution_table.party / go to a party: Party is a cheerful social gathering; going to a party shows a guest arriving or joining friends.
polysemy_resolution_table.meals / picnic / have a picnic: Meals are prepared occasions for eating; a picnic is food eaten outdoors on a blanket; having a picnic shows people sharing it outside.
polysemy_resolution_table.relax / stay (at) home: Relax means rest comfortably; stay at home means spending the leisure period inside one's home.
polysemy_resolution_table.shopping / go shopping: Shopping is the leisure activity of choosing and buying items; go shopping shows a person heading to or browsing shops, not a cashier at work.
polysemy_resolution_table.travel / vacation / go on vacation: Travel is a journey away from home; vacation is a leisure break; going on vacation shows a person setting off with travel luggage toward a holiday destination.
polysemy_resolution_table.visit a gallery / visit a museum: A gallery displays artworks; a museum displays historical, cultural, or natural exhibits. Show a visitor looking at the collection in each venue.
